ops.parking: Valet parking is available at the hotel entrance for hotel guests. Check current parking availability and rates with the hotel in advance. Barrier-free parking is also available.
ops.waitingRooms: The North Room (38㎡) on the 3rd floor of Mitsui Tower can be used for executive meetings, individual consultations, as a VIP lounge, and as an organizer's operations headquarters ("organiser command centres"). The South Room (38㎡) can be used for VIP waiting, previews, sponsor service and guest reception. Both are on the same floor as the event venues (Meetings & Events Brochure, May 2026 edition).
ops.catering: The hotel's chef team provides made-to-order catering, from light meals and working lunches to business dinners. Menus are adjusted to the program, purpose, dietary restrictions and allergies; contact the events team in advance for a consultation. The banquet menu includes breakfast, coffee breaks, lunch, bento boxes, canapés and a 2-hour drink package (Banquet Menu, March 2026 edition).
ops.restaurants: The hotel has Signature (French), The Pizza Bar on 38th, K'shiki (Italian), Tapas Molecular Bar, Sense (Cantonese cuisine), Oriental Lounge, Ventaglio, Mandarin Bar, The Cellar (private dining) and Sushi Shin by Miyakawa. The hotel states that private rooms and bespoke arrangements are available for celebrations and business dinners.
